MinebeaMitsumi.why: MinebeaMitsumi makes fan motors for AI servers (including large fan motors for high-heat servers and fans for AI server power supplies) and the miniature ball bearings inside AI-server cooling fans, plus BBU battery protection modules and server fan-motor driver ICs. The company says demand for air cooling from AI data centers remains strong, plans AI-server net sales growth at a CAGR of approx. 22% (FY3/26 - FY3/29), and reports Precision Technologies and air-cooling fans running significantly above initial targets, so its stock benefits directly as AI-server air cooling is built and sold.
MinebeaMitsumi.evidence: Results briefing deck 08-05-2026, 'Five Growth Areas: AI Servers': 'Demand for air cooling remains strong ... Bearings: Secured strong forecasts from major fan motor manufacturers ... Fan motors: Fans for AI server power supplies are performing strongly ... Large fan motors: Rapid increase in new inquiries for high-heat-generating servers'; Q&A (President Yoshida): 'Demand related to air-cooling fans remains strong. Orders for ball bearings and fan motors are extremely solid'.

players.product: fan motors for AI-server air cooling and server power supplies, and miniature ball bearings for AI-server cooling fan motors

quarterly_data.signal: Precision Technologies R&D (annual securities report; JPY 2,909 million): for fan motors that cool AI servers - one use of its miniature ball bearings - the company is developing dedicated miniature ball bearings that withstand high temperatures and high-speed rotation, as a heat countermeasure for high-load computing. As what it calls the world top-share maker of HDD pivot assemblies (used in the HDD swing arm), it is developing new products for applications from high-end data-center servers to nearline, and a dedicated grease for pivot assemblies; applying the same ultra-precision assembly, it is developing cartridge bearings for LiDAR. Other work: aircraft bearings (mechanical assemblies, trunnion bearings for main landing gear and flight-control bearings, mainly for US and European aircraft makers), link-rod assemblies vertically integrated through RO-RA Aviation Systems' swage-tube technology, a heat-resistant ball-bearing unit for turbochargers developed by myonic, and new aerospace products combining CEROBEAR ceramic and hybrid bearings with myonic's special bearings.

Group R&D, year ended March 2026 (annual securities report): JPY 49,755 million, including JPY 5,620 million of basic research not allocated to segments. Motor, Lighting & Sensing (JPY 13,949 million): HDD spindle, stepping, DC, fan and automotive motors; rare-earth bonded and high-heat-resistant magnets; ultra-thin mobile and automotive LCD backlights; LED and ultraviolet lighting; a bed-sensor monitoring system; a new thin-film strain gauge for robotics and medical sensors; and the film-type high-sensitivity strain gauge 'MINEGE' (500% or more of conventional sensitivity at 1/10 or less of the size), being commercialised for automotive, mobile / wearable and robotics. Semiconductor & Electronics (JPY 17,347 million): ABLIC's low-power, high-precision analog ICs (lithium-ion battery protection ICs, medical ICs, automotive and industrial analog ICs), Minebea Power Devices' Si-based IGBTs and power devices using next-generation materials for EVs and industrial energy saving, MEMS-based ultra-low-power sensor modules for IoT, and optical image stabilisation (OIS) camera actuators for smartphones. Access Solutions (JPY 8,555 million): mass production of electric door latches has started; sensor-integrated door handles using strain-gauge technology, compact spindle drive (CSD) and side door drive (SDD) power closures, camera monitoring system (CMS) mass-production projects and digital keys. Other JPY 1,375 million.

Targets (annual securities report): the group aims for net sales of JPY 2.5 trillion and operating income of JPY 250 billion in the fiscal year ending March 2029, the target year of its mid-term plan. Forecast for the fiscal year ending March 2027 at filing: net sales JPY 1,690,000 million, operating income JPY 120,000 million, profit attributable to owners of the parent JPY 83,000 million. Strategy: eight core businesses (the '8 Spears' - bearings, analog semiconductors, motors, access products, sensors, connectors/switches, power supplies and wireless/communications/software) combined through 'integration' into new products; the company expects humanoid robots, autonomous driving and drones to expand as new markets.

quarterly_data.signal: Business structure (annual securities report): the group is MinebeaMitsumi and 146 subsidiaries, producing in Japan, China, Thailand, the Philippines, Malaysia, Cambodia, South Korea, Singapore, the US and Europe. Precision Technologies: ball bearings, rod-end bearings, mechanical parts such as HDD pivot assemblies, and aircraft fasteners. Motor, Lighting & Sensing: electronic devices (electro devices such as LCD backlights, smart products), HDD spindle motors, sensing devices (measuring instruments), stepping motors, DC motors, fan motors, automotive motors and special equipment. Semiconductor & Electronics: semiconductor devices, optical devices, mechanical components and power supply components (producers include Mitsumi Electric, ABLIC, Minebea Connect, Honda Tsushin Kogyo and Minebea Power Devices). Access Solutions: key sets, door latches, door handles and other automotive parts (U-Shin, Minebea AccessSolutions) plus industrial-machinery parts. Other: software design and development and in-house machinery.
